# A release needs two roles, and security and product are required. One reject from a required role is a veto: the request is rejected
# although product and legal approved. The item is held for a person, and the ledger closes the request as rejected.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:ssh-keygen] skip
[!exec:sqlite3] skip
[!exec:flock] skip
[!exec:git] skip
[!exec:sha256sum] [!exec:shasum] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

approvalsinit
approvalsfakes
approvalskeys ann lee sam pat
subst home/.approval/config
env HOME=$WORK/home
env APPROVALS_DIR=$WORK/ops
env APPROVALS_WINDOW_SECONDS=300
env APPROVAL_POLL=1

exec sh ops/scripts/submit.sh msa msa.md ann
exec obeereal item add approvals req-1 --title 'Release' --body-file body.txt
exec obeereal run req-1 approvals --workflow ops/workflow.star &
waitfile notices.log
exec signoff pat product approve req-1 msa
exec signoff lee legal approve req-1 msa
exec signoff sam security reject req-1 msa
wait
stdout 'item req-1 finished'

exec sh -c 'sh ops/scripts/audit.sh req-1 - $(jq -r .head home/.approval/certs/req-1.json)'
stdout '\tsignoff\tsam\tsecurity\treject\t'
stdout '\tclosed\t.*\trejected\t'
! stdout '\tapproved\t'
grep -count=1 '^outcome-req-1 ann' notices.log
exec sqlite3 state/local.db 'SELECT state FROM items WHERE id = "req-1"'
stdout '^hold$'

-- body.txt --
{"doc":"msa","kind":"release","author":"ann"}
-- msa.md --
The release candidate.
-- home/.approval/config --
NOTIFY_API=http://notify.test
-- home/.approval/credential.header --
Authorization: Bearer TESTONLY
